name: Rajeswari Infrastructure Limited
about: Rajeswari Infrastructure Limited engages in construction and infrastructure business in India. The company operates through Construction, Service Apartment, and Printing segments. It is also involved in the rental of house property. The company was formerly known as Rajeswari Foundations Limited and changed its name to Rajeswari Infrastructure Limited in October 2009. Rajeswari Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Chennai, India.
